items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: We both had attic rooms there in this Bank Street place... I didn't even know if Jelly was from New Orleans or what color he was... until this fellow told me about him.

ctx.x: You could have met him, actually. Yeah, yeah. Quite easily.

Yeah, Jelly was living over on 131st Street, roughly. If not the 131st, some other street in there. He lived sometimes on the 131st Street. First at Joplin's house at one time, then later in the 38th he lived all the time there on the 138th, near 7th Avenue. So it would be the same section, which would have been, oh, a dozen blocks to go a little across town, and then up about six or seven blocks. And I could have seen Jelly and heard him play. He wasn't working much. That was the Depression already. So he wasn't…
How much of him had you collected before you actually met him? Had you on the complete record?
